permissions.notifications.title: Get notified when matches happen
permissions.notifications.body: We'll let you know about new matches, messages, and likes. You can change this anytime.
permissions.camera.title: Take great profile photos
permissions.camera.body: We'll use your camera for verification and profile photos. Photos stay private until you publish them.
permissions.photo_library.title: Pick photos from your library
permissions.photo_library.body: We need access to your photo library so you can add profile pictures.
permissions.location.title: Show people nearby
permissions.location.body: We use your location to show profiles closer to you. Approximate location is enough.

discover.empty.no_matches.title: You're all caught up
discover.empty.no_matches.body: Check back later for new people in your area.
discover.empty.filter_too_narrow.title: Your filters are very specific
discover.empty.filter_too_narrow.body: Try widening your country, language, or age range to discover more profiles.
discover.empty.no_results.title: No one matches your filters
discover.empty.no_results.body: Try expanding your search to see more people.
discover.empty.you_blocked_everyone.title: Nothing to show
discover.empty.you_blocked_everyone.body: You've blocked or hidden everyone matching your filters. Manage blocks in Settings.

chat.empty.no_messages.body: When you match with someone, your conversations appear here.

verification.overview.title: Get verified
verification.overview.body: Verified profiles get more matches and signal you're a real person.
verification.tier.bronze.label: Profile verified

safety.money_banner: This message mentions money. Ahavah users should never send money to someone they haven't met in person.
safety.off_platform_warning: Want to move this off-app already? Most scammers ask for this. Take your time.
safety.first_chat_tip.title: A quick safety note
safety.first_chat_tip.body: Take time to get to know someone. Never send money. Meet in public places first.
safety.report.title: Report this person
safety.report.subtitle: What's the issue? We review every report.
safety.report.success: Thanks. We'll review this within 24 hours.
safety.block.confirm.title: Block {{name}}?
safety.block.confirm.body: You won't see them and they won't see you. You can unblock anytime in Settings.
